newsitem.title: USA: Nat'l Media sees FY pre-tax loss of $40 to $45 mln.
newsitem.headline: Nat'l Media sees FY pre-tax loss of $40 to $45 mln.

text.p: National Media Corp said Monday it expects to report a pre-tax loss of $40 million to $45 million for its fiscal year ended March 31.
The company will report results for the year and the fourth fiscal quarter on July 15.

The company also said that result of its losses and its weakened cash position, it is in technical violation of certain financial ratio covenants under its loan agreement with its primary lending institution.
As a result, the company said it will receive a "going concern" opinion, rather than an unqualified opinion, from its auditors when the audit of its year-end results is completed.
The company said its loss includes about $25 million in write-offs and adjustments.

The write-offs and adjustments are principally related to its prior acquisition of Positive Response Television, excess and obsolete inventory, the carrying value and amortization of production costs, severance and legal costs, as well as non-recurring costs related to the restructuring of the company.
